kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.buka.tenang: Sit, %s. Breathe in for nine counts, out for nine. Then we begin.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.buka.keras: You are three breaths late, %s. Sit. Next time wait for me before dawn.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.buka.hangat: Ah, %s, you came. Have you eaten? Sit close, the mountain wind is cold this morning.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.buka.sombong: Hmph. Not every disciple is worthy of hearing this, %s. Count yourself lucky and keep quiet.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.tutup.tenang: Enough for today, %s. Let it settle, do not chase it. Muddy water clears when left alone.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.tutup.keras: Repeat it until your body remembers without thought, %s. I will test you next week.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.tutup.hangat: Good, %s. Slowly now. Your teacher is not going anywhere.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.tutup.sombon: If you ever shame my name on the lei tai, %s, do not call me your teacher.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.tukar.0: You have walked further than I, %s. Tell me what you saw there, and I will tell you the road I took.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.tukar.1: Realm is not everything, %s. I grew old on this road; you climbed fast. Let us weigh the two.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.tukar.2: Today the disciple teaches the teacher, %s. Do not be shy; I can still learn.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.lampaui.bang: Hahaha! %s, you have surpassed your teacher! Today I drink until I fall over!
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.lampaui.cemb: ...You have passed me, %s. Fine. But remember who led you up the first step.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.lindung: %s appears in an instant and holds %s fast! “How bold, to lay a hand on my disciple.”
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.sword.0: A sword is not the iron in your hand. It is the intent you have not yet spoken.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.sword.1: A good cut is no faster than the wind; it simply never hesitates.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.sword.2: Watch the tip of my blade. If your eyes follow the sword, you have lost. Follow the opponent's shoulder.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.sword.3: A child can memorise a thousand forms. One form trained ten thousand times is what kills.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.sword.4: When you parry, do not meet its strength. Turn it aside, as a river stone turns the current.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.sword.5: One day your sword will sing by itself in its sheath. On that day, do not grow proud.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.fire.0: Fire does not hate the wood. It is only hungry. Rule its hunger, not the flame.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.fire.1: Fire qi rises from the belly, not the chest. If your chest burns, you took the wrong channel.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.fire.2: A good furnace is tended like a baby: never too hot, never let it die.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.fire.3: Look at this ember. Deep red burns hotter than yellow; the quiet ones are often the most dangerous.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.fire.4: Never let anger light your Dao. Fire born of anger burns its owner first.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.fire.5: At the end of the road of fire lie ash and a phoenix. The difference is only patience.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.ice.0: Ice is water that decided to stop. Learn to stop without dying.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.ice.1: Cool your mind before your hands. Cold hands with a hot head only freeze.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.ice.2: See the dew on that grass. It does not force; it waits for the night to work for it.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.ice.3: The first crack in a frozen lake is never heard. Strike like that.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.ice.4: Cold qi settles in the bones. Move it every night, or it becomes an old man's ache.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.ice.5: The eternal snow peak never shouts, yet every climber bows to it.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.lightnin: Lightning does not travel; it chooses. In an instant it has decided its path.
Speed without a centre is only chaos. Still your core, then let your body burst.
Hear the thunder after the flash. The gap between is your opponent's time to regret.
Do not keep lightning qi in your arm too long. It wants out, and it has no manners.
Heaven tests us with lightning at every breakthrough. Learn from its trial now, before it comes.
The fastest blow is the one you never draw back. No wind-up, no warning.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.body.0: The body is the first furnace. Before refining pills, refine your own flesh.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.body.1: Hold the horse stance until your legs shake, then hold it a hundred breaths more.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.body.2: A bone that breaks and heals is stronger. Do not fear pain; fear idleness.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.body.3: Copper skin, iron muscle, jade bone. Three layers, three years, three thousand blows.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.body.4: Do not take a blow with muscle alone. Let the qi spread like water into soil.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.body.5: A mountain does not move, yet everything that strikes it breaks. Be that mountain.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.life.0: Every leaf knows when to fall. The Dao of life begins with accepting death.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.life.1: Touch this root. Feel its qi beating slowly? That is the rhythm you must copy.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.life.2: Healing another wears a little of yourself away. Fill it again with proper sleep and food.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.life.3: A hundred-year herb does not grow because it was forced. It grows because nobody pulled it up.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.life.4: Spring does not ask winter's leave. It simply arrives on time.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.life.5: When your qi runs dry, sit in the herb garden at dawn. The earth will share what it has left.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.shadow.0: A shadow does not hide; it only stands where no one looks.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.shadow.1: A silent step begins with a silent breath. Listen to your own breathing first.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.shadow.2: The most dangerous enemy is the one you think a friend. The Dao of shadow teaches suspicion without hatred.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.shadow.3: With the moon behind you, your shadow points at your enemy. Think of that before walking at night.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.shadow.4: Never strike twice from the same side. A shadow has no habits.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.shadow.5: Darkness is not light's enemy but where light rests. Do not fear it.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.space.0: Distance is only an agreement between two points. The ancestors learned to cancel it.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.space.1: Feel the space between your palms. Empty, yet never truly empty.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.space.2: Teleport formations are built from stone and calculation. The Dao of space is built from conviction.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.space.3: Never tear space in anger. A ragged tear will not close again.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.space.4: Your step is one, but your goal is ten li away. Learn to fold what lies between.
kultivator.gabung.pelajaran.dao.space.5: The sky above and the earth below are only two sides of the same cloth.
